stop_reason: GSE226005 contains no exercise contrast: all 12 samples are human IMR90 fibroblasts (Senescent/Young, Hypoxia/Normoxia, 2-DG+Hypoxia/Hypoxia control). The paper's exercise estimand (running vs sedentary mouse gastrocnemius, snRNA-seq, S2.7.p1, S5.15.p1) is not in this series, so no exercise effect can be identified from these data. Analyzing a senescence or hypoxia contrast would not answer the exercise question.
